name: A. Stephen Kotler
tagline: Top rated Estate Planning & Probate attorney in Naples, Florida
about: Steve Kotler is an AV Rated, Florida Bar Board Certified Wills, Trusts and Estates lawyer practicing in Naples, Florida. Steve maintains a practice in the areas of comprehensive wealth transfer planning, related income tax issues, trusts, asset preservation, probate, trust administration, federal transfer tax, elder law and special needs. He is very active in and holds leadership positions with both the Real Property, Probate and Trust Law and Elder Law Sections of the Florida Bar and is a frequent speaker and writer on topics related to his practice areas. He received his JD from Emory Law School and has a master of laws in Estate Planning from the University of Miami School of Law. Away from the office, you can probably find Steve doing something with his kids, his cars or both. He is also an instrument rated private pilot with no time to fly.
